verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party way to operate Obsidian with natural-language commands. The Command Palette, Obsidian URI actions, the plugin API and headless Sync for agents are adjacent controls or developer building blocks, not natural-language operation. The LLM capability mentioned (Text-Generator and Copilot) comes from third-party community plugins, which are user-side add-ons rather than the product's own feature, so none of this earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
